lines.text: Boaz sits at the gate, gathers ten elders, and offers the nearer kinsman-redeemer Elimelech's land, and he says he will redeem it.
Boaz says the land comes with Ruth, so the man refuses, fearing for his own inheritance, and gives Boaz his cloak.

wrong_details.true: removes his sandal and gives it to Boaz

lines.text: Boaz tells the witnesses he has acquired Ruth, and they bless him to be like Rachel and Leah and Perez.
Boaz marries Ruth, and she bears a son, whom Ruth names Obed, and Naomi nurses him.

wrong_details.true: the neighbor women name him Obed

lines.text: Obed becomes the father of Jesse, and Jesse becomes the father of David, in the line of Perez.
